payload.reason: The hydraulic conductivity (K_H) values used in the study are derived from fixed values specified for different stratigraphies, with a constant value of 10^-5 m s^-1 for well-drained conditions and 10^-4 m s^-1 for saturated conditions.

claims.text: The saturated hydraulic conductivity (K_H) is fixed at 10^-5 m s^-1 for all stratigraphies in the study.
The study also uses a saturated hydraulic conductivity of 10^-4 m s^-1 in the snow model for certain conditions.
